digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Friday closed with the Juniper decision completed, while Amazon Connect delivery risk and the Re-Open Cases dependency remain the main carry-forwards. Monday begins with reduced leadership coverage, so the open owners and next dates should be explicit before the week gets moving.

items.label: Closed the Juniper Labs go/no-go decision
items.detail: The pilot decision item was completed today after the scheduled debrief.

items.label: Started the Change Management participation outreach
items.detail: Jean sent the internal invitation and confirmed Camilo's interest in joining the initiative.

items.label: Routed two new intake requests to the CM-CoE
items.detail: The Mental Health Evaluation 2.0 task-set request and the New Package Types request were acknowledged and routed for evaluation and prioritization.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect recovery plan and unblock UAT
items.detail: Align the internal response, leadership escalation, source-of-truth plan, RAID ownership, voicemail fix, remaining queue phone numbers, tester coverage, and a credible revised UAT date before communication resumes with SaltClick.

items.label: Assign coverage for Friday's remaining 3:00 PM collision
items.detail: Legal Change Management was cancelled, but the Litify Sprint 15 review and Executive Project Status Slide Update still overlap at 3:00 PM. Confirm who covered each outcome and capture any follow-through.

items.label: Close the Re-Open Cases SOP and handoff path
items.detail: The project is waiting for Leo's requested SOP feedback. Jean shared that if it arrives next week, Gustavo should be able to exit the project within a week or less; confirm the feedback date and final due date.

items.label: Close the vendor document quality follow-up
items.detail: Use the 10:30 AM 1:1 to confirm the quality problem, decide whether escalation is warranted, and assign ownership for the vendor-ready version.

items.label: Name owners and dates for PM capacity gaps
items.detail: Turn yesterday's capacity discussion into named owners and availability dates for Amazon Connect, UAT, and the portfolio gaps that still need coverage.

items.label: Terminar Hoja de Jorge
items.detail: Finish the sheet so it is ready for the next UAT and portfolio discussion.

items.label: Submit the Spencer Huffman interview feedback
items.detail: Send the Project Manager III assessment so the hiring process is no longer waiting on Jean's feedback.

items.label: Review the new Supabase security alert
items.detail: Verify the affected project and severity, then assign remediation without assuming it is the same issue previously closed.

items.label: Decide the home for CSC/LC Green Approval
items.detail: Mar's review says the new intake does not fit CoE scope and should return to PMO as a standard project. Confirm the routing and owner so the request does not sit between portfolios.

items.label: Legal Change Management - IT & EPMO Sync was cancelled
items.detail: The 10:00 AM calendar occurrence was explicitly cancelled.

items.label: Business analyst coverage was assigned for two projects
items.detail: Ernestina Aguirrezabala was assigned to RFE - Mental Health Evaluation, and Rahul Bhat was assigned to USCIS E-Filing.

items.label: Plan around reduced leadership and project coverage
items.detail: Sara is out, Nadia is on PTO, and Mar is out from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM. Set explicit coverage for Amazon Connect and portfolio escalations.

items.label: 8:00-10:30 AM - Weekly setup and Legal Change Management
items.detail: Approve timecards and prepare the week at 8:00 AM, then use the 10:00 AM Legal Change Management sync to close ownership and IT follow-through left from Friday.

items.label: Noon-3:30 PM - Focus time, BD review, and Maria
items.detail: Protect the noon blocked hour, use the 2:00 PM BD Portfolio Review for dependency decisions, and carry the resulting owners into the 3:00 PM 1:1 with Maria.
